<!--
Title format: <type>(<scope>): <imperative subject>
  type ∈ feat / enhance / fix / refactor / style / chore / tech / revert
  scope ∈ catalog / trips / ui / db / infra / governance / deps / release
See _governance-local/decisions/ADR-0005-commit-conventions.md.

Keep "## Tickets" as the LAST section: the squash-merge uses this body, and
git-cliff only picks up Refs:/Closes: trailers at the very end.
-->

## Summary

<!-- One to three sentences: what changed and why. -->

## Changes

<!-- The notable changes, as a short list. -->

-

## Test plan

<!-- How this was verified: commands run, flows exercised, screenshots. -->

-

## Spec & decisions

<!-- Link the feature spec and any ADRs this implements or introduces. -->

- Spec:
- ADRs:

## Tickets

<!-- MUST be the last section. Use the colon form. Every PR references an issue.
       Closes: #N   completes issue N (auto-closes on merge)
       Refs: #N     contributes to issue N without closing it
-->

Closes: #N
